# Issue 9: Add placement validation

## Summary

Warn users about overlaps, wall-boundary violations, doorway problems, and blocked walkways.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Object overlap detection
- [ ] Wall-boundary detection
- [ ] Doorway warning
- [ ] Walking-path warning
- [ ] Warnings are visually and textually accessible
- [ ] Non-critical warnings may be overridden

## Notes

Validation should be testable without UI where possible. Keep warning copy understandable and non-sensitive in logs.
